name: jacquard-rle-checker
description: 提花编织口令校验：定宽符号网格与逐行游程口令双向转换

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,client -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w packages/shared" "npm run dev -w packages/server" "npm run dev -w packages/client"
